email.__description__: Outgoing email contact methods; awaits an inbound reply.

inbound_provider.description: How the reply arrives: mailgun, postmark, sendgrid, smtp_server, or stdio (dev mode). Omit for link-only reply.

from_address.description: Sender address shown in From:. Not required when inbound_provider is 'stdio'.

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname. Not required when inbound_provider is 'stdio'.

smtp_password.description: SMTP password. Prefer a $VAR reference to an environment variable; read paths mask it.

reply_domain.description: Domain for Reply-To: interaction-{id}@reply_domain. Not required when inbound_provider is 'stdio'.

response_base_url.description: Base URL of the user source REST API (link in email body + inbound endpoint). Not required when inbound_provider is 'stdio'.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a reply.

webhook.__description__: Outgoing webhook contact methods; POSTs a question and awaits a response via the user source REST API.

url.description: POST target for outgoing questions. Incoming-webhook URLs are often credentials themselves, so read paths mask it; may be a $VAR reference.

response_base_url.description: Base URL of the user source REST API (response_url sent in payload).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for the outgoing POST (e.g. Authorization). Values may be $VAR references; read paths mask them.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a response.

sms.__description__: SMS / text-message contact methods. Recorded only: no built-in transport in this release, so the system never contacts the user through it.

messaging.__description__: Instant-messaging contact methods (Slack, Teams, Discord, …). Recorded only: no built-in transport in this release, so the system never contacts the user through it.

handle.description: Username or handle on the platform.

enterprise.__description__: Enterprise directory contact methods (LDAP, Active Directory, …). Recorded only: no built-in transport in this release, so the system never contacts the user through it.

notification.__description__: Push-notification contact methods (webhook, push token, …). Recorded only: no built-in transport in this release, so the system never contacts the user through it.

endpoint.description: Notification endpoint URL or push token. Read paths mask it.

session.__description__: In-session / interactive contact methods. Recorded only: no built-in transport in this release, so the system never contacts the user through it.

session_id.description: Session identifier (omit to use the active session).
